sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-heretic NVFP4 + DFlash on DGX Spark
sources.snippet: A production-stable deployment of AEON-7/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-heretic-NVFP4 with DFlash speculative decoding on NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 / sm_121a). ⚠️ READ THE REQUIREMENTS SECTION FIRST. This image and its weights are tuned specifically for the DGX Spark (GB10 / sm_120-121 Blackwell). It will NOT work on Hopper, Ampere, B200, or other Blackwell variants without rebuilding.
